user.title: Domat UI room unit
user.description: Adds a Domat UI room unit to a hub of the Modbus integration (defined under `modbus:` in configuration.yaml).

data.name: Name
data.unit: Modbus address of the room unit

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the room unit. Check the address, wiring and baud rate.
error.not_domat: The device answered but its module ID is not a Domat UI room unit.

abort.already_configured: This room unit is already configured.
abort.no_hubs: No Modbus hub found. Define one under `modbus:` in configuration.yaml (serial, rtuovertcp or tcp) and restart Home Assistant.

set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes day/night/off events to the room unit's weekly schedule (stored in the unit) and enables the day/night time schedule.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to program: mon..sun, weekdays, weekend or all.

events.name: Events
events.description: Up to 6 events like "06:00 day", "22:00 night" or "23:00 off". Other slots are cleared.
